name: empty_strided
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI), copied verbatim: aten::empty_strided(SymInt[] size, SymInt[] stride, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=None) -> Tensor. This is the `default` overload; it is representative and NOT exclusive. The original Gems pytest owns the full contract: every registered overload, keyword argument, return value, error, aliasing and mutation behavior must keep its coverage, and tests must never be narrowed or the reference adapted to fit this one signature. All registered signatures from the supplied schema evidence, verbatim: `aten::empty_strided(SymInt[] size, SymInt[] stride, *, ScalarType? dtype=None, Layout? layout=None, Device? device=None, bool? pin_memory=None) -> Tensor` and `aten::empty_strided.out(SymInt[] size, SymInt[] stride, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!)`. Semantics derived from the pytest: empty_strided allocates fresh, uninitialized storage for a requested size/stride pair and has no tensor operand, so it broadcasts nothing and computes no element value. The default overload returns a brand-new tensor that is not a view, does not require grad, and whose shape, stride, dtype, device, storage_offset (0), numel, underlying storage nbytes, contiguity and non-overlapping-and-dense state match the native allocation; storage is sized from the requested strides, so it may be smaller than numel (overlapping strides) or larger (padded strides), zero-element sizes yield empty storage, and each call returns distinct storage rather than a cached buffer. Element contents are undefined except when deterministic algorithms plus fill_uninitialized_memory are enabled, in which case they must match exactly (NaN with equal_nan). Optional keyword arguments are honored individually and their omitted forms fall back to schema defaults (dtype, layout, device, pin_memory); pin_memory is only valid for dense CPU storage and is rejected on the accelerator. The `out` overload is not represented here but remains fully covered by pytest: it is keyword-only, mutates and resizes the supplied buffer in place, aliases and returns that same tensor, reusing its storage when large enough and reallocating otherwise, without honoring the requested strides on the resize path. The ATen `None` defaults for dtype/layout/device/pin_memory are non-JSON sentinels rendered as JSON null; they are optional and their omission is a tested boundary.
